'''Little Petrovi''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Little Petrovi system/Legends|Little Petrovi system]], a part of the [[Yushan sector/Legends|Yushan sector]]<ref name="EAOC Little Petrovi" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="WesternReaches" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC Little Petrovi" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which linked it to the [[Jiroch system/Legends|Jiroch]], [[Kaal system/Legends|Kaal]],<ref name="EGTW" /> and [[Dalisor system/Legends|Dalisor systems]].<ref name="Dalisor">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' places Little Petrovi between the [[Jiroch system/Legends|Jiroch]] and [[Kaal system/Legends|Kaal systems]] on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' also places the [[Dalisor system/Legends|Dalisor system]] on that same section of the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]].</ref>

By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Little Petrovi fell within the territory controlled by the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]], and that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] fought a [[Battle of Little Petrovi|battle]] there as part of the [[Western Reaches Operation]], a campaign targeting [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] remnants that itself constituted a part of the Imperial [[Reconquest of the Rim]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Little Petrovi was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Little Petrovi [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square K-17.<ref name="EAOC Little Petrovi" />
